summary: Final professional consultant-style presentation of the Wholesale Management System (Guddu Traders) written in Roman Urdu. Covers all 12 phases: Executive Summary, Architecture, Business Flow, all Modules, Financial Calculations with formulas, Database ER overview, Reports analysis, Strengths, Weaknesses with solutions, Missing ERP features with priority roadmap, Conclusion, and Future Vision. Includes Mermaid flowcharts and tables throughout.
